desc: Establish monotonicity after sorting all three positive arrays in descending order.
Design max-heap traversal from \((0,0,0)\) with coordinate-increment neighbors.
Confirm that a visited set is necessary for the unrestricted three-neighbor traversal.
Implement the visited-set heap algorithm with efficient value computation.
Validate exactly K pops produce the K-th largest value, including ties and repeated array elements.
Analyze practical time and memory usage for \(N\le2\times10^5,\ K\le5\times10^5\), and provide the complete stdin/stdout program.
